user.title: Add an ICS calendar
user.description: A calendar from any ICS (iCalendar) address, such as the secret address of a Google, Outlook or Nextcloud calendar.

data_description.name: Name of the calendar entity, for example Family.
data_description.url: The address of the .ics feed. It is checked once before the calendar is added, and never written to the log.

reconfigure.title: Change the calendar
reconfigure.description: Change the name or the ICS address. The calendar entity and its history stay the same.

data_description.name: Name of the calendar entity.
data_description.url: The address of the .ics feed. It is checked once before the change is saved.

error.cannot_connect: Could not download a calendar from this address. Check the address and that it can be reached from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_ics: This address does not return an ICS calendar.
error.already_configured: Another calendar already uses this address.

abort.already_configured: This calendar is already set up.

data_description.refresh_minutes: How often the calendar is downloaded again, in minutes.
data_description.days_backward: Days in the past that events stay available.
data_description.days_forward: Days ahead that events, including repeating events, are shown.
